title: Week 10 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “jurisdiction”?
options: The official process of compiling, reviewing, and certifying election returns.
The election in which voters choose among nominees and decide public offices or measures.
A legal, technological, financial, strategic, or structural obstacle to new competition.
A court’s legal authority to hear and decide a category of case.
questions.explanation: Jurisdiction means a court’s legal authority to hear and decide a category of case.

A good that can replace another good in consumption or production.
A union in which member states retain substantial sovereignty and the central authority is limited.

options: The constitutional formula counting three-fifths of enslaved persons for representation and direct taxation.

An alliance of groups or individuals cooperating toward shared political goals.
The process through which people develop political values, identities, and habits.

options: The president’s constitutional role directing the armed forces.

Uncertainty arising because a survey measures a sample rather than the entire population.
The principle of generally following established precedent while allowing justified departure.

options: A student quotes or paraphrases the court’s holding and does not treat a dissent, headline, or advocate’s summary as controlling law.

A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
